findings: Generous registration tolerances — test_register_similarity_recovers_known_rotation_and_scale allows |scale - 1.25| < 0.12 (~10% relative error) and <=12 degrees rotation error. A moderately regressed implementation could pass without detection. Consider tightening to <=0.05 / <=5 degrees in a follow-up once the real-image suite gives calibration data, or add a comment explaining why these margins are intentional.

ModelError path covers schema-validation failure only — test_build_model_error_becomes_warning fires ModelError by feeding an empty JSON object that fails KolamDescribeDTO validation. The TIMEOUT and API-level-failure categories of ModelError are not tested. Noting for future work to add a timeout-simulation variant.

importlib.util coupling blocks collection on run_eval.py errors — test_kolam_eval.py imports run_eval.py at module import time (during collection). A syntax error or broken import in run_eval.py surfaces as a collection error on the test file, not a single test failure.
